specs.Compatible Phone Models: iPhone 15, MacBook, iPad 10, Samsung Galaxy S23 and other Type C Smartphone & Devices.

features: 6.0Amp Super-Fast Charging: Portronics Konnect X is a USB to Type-C Cable designed to fast charge your Android smartphone, tablets & other Type-C enabled devices.

High-quality Nylon Braided: Designed for long-lasting durability, this cable features high-quality nylon weave and aluminum shells, effectively preventing wear and tear over time. The tangle-free design ensures lasting reliability.

Fast Charging & Data Sync: The USB to Type C cable enables rapid charging and supports the swift transfer of videos, photos, files, etc., at a speed of 480 Mbps between your Type C devices and USB devices.
1 Meter Portable Cable: With a convenient 1-meter length, this Type C cable is perfect for use at home, in the office, in the car, during travel, and anywhere else you need it.
Warranty: The Konnect X USB to Type C cable has a warranty of 6 months against manufacturing defects.
description: The Portronics Konnect X is a high-performance USB to 8-Pin Cable designed for lightning-fast charging at 3.0A max output. Engineered with an unbreakable nylon braided cord and aluminum shells, it ensures durability and wear resistance. The 1-meter length makes it perfect for home, office, car, and travel use. Achieve fast charging and efficient data transfer at 480 Mbps, all backed by a 6-month warranty against manufacturing defects. Upgrade your charging experience with the Konnect X for reliable performance and lasting quality.
